# CareNote: Longitudinal Clinical Memory & Verifiable PaperTrail

> Medical history is not a static text chunk. It is an evolving knowledge graph across time. CareNote turns fragmented clinical encounter PDFs into a persistent bi-temporal patient knowledge graph, producing longitudinal clinical syntheses where assertions can be inspected against source records through The PaperTrail.

## Core architectural thesis

Standard vector retrieval can lose temporal state across fragmented records. It may retrieve discontinued medications alongside active regimens, repeat copied-forward problem-list labels, and obscure relationships across encounters. CareNote models patient history as an evolving graph with explicit validity boundaries and source anchors.

## Human-facing discovery pages

- [AI medical record summarization for longitudinal chart review](https://carenote.in/longitudinal-chart-review): Human-facing guide to changing clinical state, evidence provenance, contradictions, unresolved work, and CareNote's research-stage approach.
- [Longitudinal Clinical Synthesis Guide](https://carenote.in/clinical-record-synthesis): CareNote's detailed category and workflow guide.

## Access and availability

CareNote is currently a curated clinical pilot and design-partner preview. Self-service signup is gated. Collaborators and researchers can review the public research framing and contact route without submitting patient data.
